carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal ridge is visible along the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance top edge and a deep shadow gradient immediately below, running from the mid-body toward the posterior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, irregular high-luminance white patch is visible on the lower posterior flank, suggesting a significant healed scar or depigmented lesion.
other_distinctive_markers: Several smaller fusiform silhouettes, identified as remoras, are visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface of the shark.
